findings.title: dispatchLenses reimplements the writeDispatchBrief helper it should call
findings.detail: Task 12 introduces r.writeDispatchBrief(dest, render) (lines 639-650) precisely to pair renderFresh with writeStableBriefAt once (#51). dispatchLenses's per-lens loop (lines 772-785) inlines exactly that sequence — text, _, rerr := renderFresh(lensBrief); ...; writeStableBriefAt(p, text, lensBrief) — instead of calling r.writeDispatchBrief(p, lensBrief), which would do the same thing since dest (p) is always non-empty here. The new helper is used at one of its two natural call sites and duplicated at the other, within the same task's own diff.

findings.title: retro.go re-declares gate.EvReviewed under a different local name
findings.detail: evGateReviewed = "gate_reviewed" duplicates the exported gate.EvReviewed (internal/gate/gate.go:47, also "gate_reviewed") even though retro.go already imports internal/gate (used elsewhere in the file, e.g. gate.FollowUp, gate.SourceApprove). Task 10's cmd_review.go uses gate.EvReviewed directly for the same event type; task 11 instead re-declares the same string under a new unexported name rather than reusing the existing constant it could import.

findings.title: RemoveReceipt uses fs.ErrNotExist where the rest of gate.go uses os.ErrNotExist
findings.detail: ReadReceipt (line 179) and artifactHash (line 125) both check errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) for the identical sentinel. The new RemoveReceipt checks errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) instead, which required adding a new "io/fs" import solely for a spelling that os.ErrNotExist (== fs.ErrNotExist) already covers via the package's existing "os" import. Minor departure from the file's own established convention.

findings.title: PRTitleQuoted duplicates the existing shellQuote escaping helper
findings.detail: internal/cli/archive.go:354 already has shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" } for the identical purpose — escaping a string for a POSIX single-quoted word inside an instruction a session runs verbatim through a shell (used there for `git clean -fd -- <path>`). PRTitleQuoted re-implements the same close-escape-reopen algorithm (minus the surrounding quotes, left to the template) in a different package instead of factoring one shared helper, so the same shell-quoting rule now lives in two places that could drift independently.
